sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In the following sections, we describe the design of the model architecture, provide details on its training procedures, present the experimental results of pre-trained and post-trained models, and finally, conclude this technical report by summarizing the key findings and outlining potential directions for future research.
